{{Top}} {{Structure |image=[[File:T_and_J.png]] |name=T&J Repair |constructed= |destroyed= |type= |location=*[[Ord Mantell]]{{TBB|Plan 99 (episode)}} *[[Serolonis]]{{TBB|Faster}} *[[Suria space station]]{{TBB|Bad Territory}} |interest= |rebuilt= |builder= |height= |width= |affiliation= }} '''T&J Repair''' was a vehicle repair shop on the [[planet]] [[Serolonis]], in [[Ord Mantell City]] on [[Ord Mantell]], and in [[Suria space station]]. [[Aurebesh]] [[Painting|advertisement]]s were used to market it. It showed the company's logo over a picture of an unknown vehicle. There was an alternate version of the ad, which only showed the vehicle, in Ord Mantell City. ==Behind the scenes== The name of the business can be identified via an [[Aurebesh]] [[Painting|advertisement]] that appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'' episode "[[Faster]]." The ampersand symbol (&) does not appear in any ''Star Wars'' mappings of Aurebesh; the typographical symbol in the business' logo is a fan-made ampersand, originally created for a fan-made font called Aurabesh, originally developed by Mike E. Webb in 1996 and available to be downloaded online.{{WebCite|url=https://aurekfonts.github.io/?font=Aurabesh|text=Aurabesh (free)|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/pcu89|archivedate=2023-01-20}}

{{Twitter|AurekFonts|status/1286777573985275904|AurekFonts|date=July 24, 2020|quote=In 1996 Mike E Web created a fan font for Aurebesh, called "Aurabesh." https://aurekfonts.github.io/?font=Aurabesh Because this was created before the above punctuation was made, Web went ahead and added his own custom punctuation, including the first Aurebesh ampersand!|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/pcu89}} ==Appearances== *{{TBB|Faster}} {{C|First mentioned, in [[Painting|advertisement]] only}} *{{TBB|Plan 99 (episode)}} {{C|Advertisement only}} *{{TBB|Bad Territory}} {{C|Advertisement only}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/plan-99-episode-guide|text="Plan 99" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Reparaciones T&J |ja=T&Jリペア |ka=ტ-ს და ჯ-ს შეკეთება }} [[Category:Repair and salvage yards]] [[Category:Serolonis locations]]
